skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply statistical methods to analyze quality data.
Collect and process statistical data for quality management.
Understand and apply quality management principles and practices.
Analyze and interpret statistical data to make informed decisions.
Identify and solve quality-related issues using statistical tools.
Collaborate effectively in group projects and presentations.
Effectively communicate statistical findings and quality analysis results.
Conduct independent research and analyze data using statistical software.
Use statistical insights to support quality management decisions.
Understand and apply ethical principles in quality management.
